summary: The diff implements DataView.prototype.getFloat16 by delegating to the shared get_view_value helper with ElementType::Float16. Step 1 binds this to view. Step 2 passes args.get_or_undefined(1) instead of setting false; this is observably equivalent because GetViewValue step 4 applies ToBoolean, which is side-effect free and gives false for undefined. Step 3 is delegated to the helper with the same arguments. No branches key on test inputs, no errors are swallowed, and no values are fabricated. The only other change is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target, which is within the edited function. I could not inspect the helper's internals (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex ordering, the out-of-bounds and range checks), so those steps are unverified beyond the gate's 36 new passing test262 runs with 0 regressions.
